start: Up next page 'Pick a program or build one', or the programs list, then Build a plan

must_not: The answers of an old build shown as new without saying so

steps.action: Pick answers and tap 'Next' through 'Days a week' and 'Split', 'Equipment', 'Go easy on', 'Time per workout'
user_sees: Each step in turn, 'Step <n> of 5'; on the last 'Build my plan'
The plan: its name, '<n> days a week · <min> min · <equipment>', 'Routines' with each day's exercises
must_not: An exercise that needs gear the member does not have

user_sees: The Workout tab with the new plan's folder open; Up next shows its first routine
must_not: Two copies of the plan after a double tap
The plan sent to any server or AI

start: Build a plan, step 'Go easy on'

user_sees: Page 'Leave out' 'Tap the exercises you never want.'
must_not: Exercises the member made themselves offered as if they had a catalogue key

user_sees: '2 exercises left out', then back on the step with the two as chips with ✕
must_not: The two still in the built plan

user_sees: The Workout tab with the plan's folder open; the old plan still the one followed

start: Build a plan, the save fails

steps.action: Tap 'Save and follow' when the phone cannot write
user_sees: 'Could not save the plan' 'Please try again.'
must_not: The builder closed with the plan lost

steps.action: Pick 'Bodyweight' equipment and every sore area
user_sees: A plan that still has exercises for each day, or a plain word why not

start: Build a plan, on step 3 of 5

user_sees: Step 2 of 5 with the answers kept
must_not: The builder closed with the answers lost

steps.action: Build the plan, then tap 'Change answers'
On the plan, swap one exercise
user_sees: A list of other exercises for it; the plan with the new one
must_not: The swap offering an exercise left out or for a sore area
